mapper.select: SELECT BASE_ROLE FROM "USER" WHERE ID = #{_parameter} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT R.ROLE_ID AS roleId , R.ROLE_DISPLAY_NAME AS roleDisplayName FROM "USER" U INNER JOIN "ROLE" R ON U.BASE_ROLE = R.ROLE_ID WHERE U.ID = #{_parameter} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT DISTINCT A.ACTION_CODE FROM ROLE_ACTION RA INNER JOIN ACTION A ON RA.ACTION_ID = A.ACTION_ID WHERE RA.ROLE_ID = #{_parameter} AND A.ACTION_CODE IS NOT NULL
SELECT ACTION_CODE FROM ACTION WHERE ACTION_CODE IS NOT NULL
